sessions.title: Community Dashboard Architecture
sessions.summary: Stefan brought a client project: a Community Member Tracking Dashboard (free + paid Skool communities). Hermes diagnosed the core issue as a data ownership problem, not a dashboard problem — five fragmented systems (HubSpot, Fiducia, Excel, Slack, Skool) with no single source of truth. Designed a 5-phase Supabase-backed architecture: retire HubSpot for pipeline, own data at point of capture, role-based setter access via the dashboard. An existing HTML prototype at ~/Desktop/community-dashboard.html was confirmed, built in a prior ~865-message Claude Code session with full KubeCraft styling.

sessions.title: Recall Studio SaaS Build
sessions.summary: Built the Recall Studio (later 'Resource Studio') — a Node.js app at ~/Documents/New project/ that turns YouTube transcripts into structured Recall Packs with visual artifacts. Major reframe mid-session: the product is not a summarizer but a 'Transcript-to-Resource Studio' — turning transcripts into publishable resources (assessments, microsites, guides, infographics). Visual DNA layer added so outputs have an art direction spine before any artifacts are generated. The KubeCraft assessment (kubecraftassessment.netlify.app) was used as the reference output quality standard.
